_meta.note: KAS 0.66.70 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.35.1 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3` WITHOUT `--auth-method cli`, so the engine leaves its credential callback on the wire for the client to answer. Driven over stdio by a scratch client; agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except the session id, replaced with a fixed synthetic value, and the scratch work dir, which reads as /work. On connect the engine sent `_kiro/auth/getAccessToken` with empty params (frame id 0) -- the request this host answers from its own credential vault; the scratch client answered it with a synthetic, non-credential token so the session could proceed, and session/new then succeeded. The engine's request carries no secret; the answer (which would) is client-to-agent and off this capture. Host-inventory frames are omitted (_kiro/* notifications and every session/update), as is the session/new response's agent and entitlement list (kept TRIMMED to sessionId and modes.currentModeId). The initialize response is kept: no agentInfo, and its agentCapabilities._meta.kiro.extensionMethods marks it KAS, not kiro-cli.
